Message:
wifi: rtw89: parse phycap of TX/RX antenna number

Two fields, TX/RX ANT NUM, are introduced to address variant TX/RX antenna
number of hardware. For example, a 1x1 chip with TX diversity, TX NSS = 1
and TX/RX ANT NUM = 2.
